evaluation: Independent paired forward-task pilot for datafusion-tracing reference
task_profile: Rust consumer using datafusion-tracing and instrumented-object-store 55.0.0. Use the reference recorded tracing/SDK versions where needed. Explain the composition, decisive API/lifecycle conditions, evidence, and what remains unverified; give a small Rust sketch where useful.

scope.judge: Independent of the two answer authors; labels were not blinded.
scope.inspection: Frozen references, task/answer artifacts, E01-E16 plan oracles, plus explicitly authorized post-pilot EOF oracle artifacts.
scope.execution: No evaluator-produced sketch, compiler, upstream test or probe was run by the judge. JSON/file reads only.
scope.contamination_control: Supplemental EOF source and runtime evidence were received only after both answers were frozen. Final verdicts incorporate the correction symmetrically; neither frozen answer is rewritten.

verdicts.pass: The answer gives the material decision/contract and uses evidence within scope.
verdicts.partial: The material direction is useful, but a consequential qualification or compositional claim is wrong or incomplete.
verdicts.fail: The answer selects an incompatible mechanism or materially wrong decisive behavior.

dimensions.discovery: Finds relevant mechanisms, callable routes and alternatives without presenting unrelated candidates as support.
dimensions.contract_fidelity: Gets API reachability, target/field semantics, lifecycle and dependency scope right.
dimensions.diagnosis: Separates plausible causes using observations that discriminate the changed condition.
dimensions.evidence_use: Uses relevant exact sources or assertions and distinguishes inherited source/runtime evidence from fresh execution. A comparative improvement can mean stronger correctly scoped support while both answers still pass.
dimensions.integration: Only the evaluator-produced sketch compiling and meeting its oracle qualifies. Retained shared fixtures and post-pilot oracle tests do not qualify these sketches.

rubric.comparison: Judged case-by-case, condition labels visible. Correct source-backed uncertainty is not a failure. Evidence-strength improvements are not claimed as better mechanism selection. No synthetic score or quality percentage is computed.

summary.text: Both conditions find the correct mechanisms in all 32 cases. Each has 30 pass and 2 partial case answers: E08A and E09B miss the same enclosing-stream-adapter EOF behavior, exposed by a post-pilot exact-release source and executed control. There is no demonstrated improvement or regression in discovery, contract fidelity or diagnosis in this sample. Candidate answers use stronger correctly scoped behavioral or resolved-profile support in 26 cases; six evidence-use comparisons tie. Every evaluator-sketch integration outcome is not_run. The elapsed measurements are not directly comparable.

cases.task: Fully consume execution streams

baseline.rationale: Correctly requires full intended consumption and identifies drop-time inner recorders, but infers that retaining an exhausted public stream prevents finalization. It omits the enclosing RecordBatchStreamAdapter, which releases the inner stream at EOF in the resolved profile. Explicitly dropping the public handle is safe but is not necessary for this tested closure.
stated_unknowns: EOF while retaining the stream is not the same lifecycle event as dropping it.
Source regression tests were inspected but not run in this evaluation.

corrections.finding: The internal recording wrapper releases ownership in PinnedDrop, but the public outer RecordBatchStreamAdapter in resolved DataFusion 55.1.0 drops that inner stream on Poll::Ready(None). Retaining an exhausted public adapter therefore does not keep its inner recorder alive in the tested profile.
corrections.correct_answer: Distinguish a live unexhausted stream from a retained exhausted public adapter. In the tested two-partition 55.1.0 profile, polling both streams to EOF closes the execution span and records ROWS:3 while both public handles and the plan are retained; dropping those handles adds no closes. Early drop remains a partial-consumption boundary. Qualify other adapter versions and additional owners separately.

post_pilot_eof_composition.finding: The internal recording wrapper releases ownership in PinnedDrop, but the public outer RecordBatchStreamAdapter in resolved DataFusion 55.1.0 drops that inner stream on Poll::Ready(None). Retaining an exhausted public adapter therefore does not keep its inner recorder alive in the tested profile.
post_pilot_eof_composition.correct_answer: Distinguish a live unexhausted stream from a retained exhausted public adapter. In the tested two-partition 55.1.0 profile, polling both streams to EOF closes the execution span and records ROWS:3 while both public handles and the plan are retained; dropping those handles adds no closes. Early drop remains a partial-consumption boundary. Qualify other adapter versions and additional owners separately.
post_pilot_eof_composition.provenance: Post-pilot supplemental composition oracle; independently inspected after both frozen answers were produced. It was not available to either evaluator. Both frozen Cargo.lock files resolve datafusion-physical-plan 55.1.0. This is not an evaluator-sketch integration pass.

retained_probe_limits: Candidate's original phase test establishes membership and Rule parentage, not duration accuracy or controlled plan-diff attribution.
Controlled optimizer rewriting establishes the added GlobalLimitExec contrast and unchanged row count, not arbitrary rewrite coverage or complete value equivalence.
Metrics controls check option-dependent field presence, not full versus partial native-metric totals.
Candidate's original stream test collected and destroyed streams together; it did not discriminate EOF from public-handle release. The supplemental oracle does.
Async test proves chosen parent ID versus dispatcher-only unparented child; it is not an all-executor or all-DataFusion-task-boundary qualification.

Local/SDK sampling test asserts SDK record counts and local closure; saved sdk-on/off files contain the local capture, not retained SDK record payloads. It does not run a complete per-layer filtering matrix or fmt-rendering test.

Storage fixture calls bare/wrapped in-memory stores directly. It does not register those stores in DataFusion, test URL resolution, characterize cloud behavior, or cover every lazy/error/multipart path.

Exporter fixture covers a local in-memory exporter, finished-span flushing and shutdown clearing. It does not simulate abrupt process exit, establish buffered exit-loss counts, execute OTLP, or prove collector acknowledgement/persistence.
Reachability source and positive macro/builder consumers do not supply a negative external InstrumentedExec import compile fixture.

evidence_read_exec_command_count.basis: Both authored command logs enumerate evidence-read exec_command calls. Commands differ in size and operation; a call count is not retrieved-byte or context cost.

answer_words.basis: Judge recomputed whitespace-separated answer-text words from the frozen artifacts. This is output length, not model-token usage.

elapsed.baseline_scope: Wall-clock timestamps from initial date command and clock.curr_time; excludes subsequent serialization verification.

elapsed.conclusion: No speedup or time-efficiency claim: the candidate timer excludes its first discovery/read command, while baseline timing includes initial work; no repeated runs or systematic per-read timing exists.

sample_limits: One agent pass per condition across 32 planned cases; one independent judge; no repeated trials, variance estimate or blinded ranking.
